Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.

seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.

panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.

desk.

Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of

panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Dam Lobby
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Dam Lobby
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Deep Canyon
>Beg pardon?
>

>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Dam Lobby
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Dam Lobby
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.
>You are in the north end of a large cavernous room which was formerly
a reservoir.
However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream
running through the center of the room.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Dam Lobby
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.
>You are in the north end of a large cavernous room which was formerly
a reservoir.
However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream
running through the center of the room.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Dam Lobby
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.
>You are in the north end of a large cavernous room which was formerly
a reservoir.
However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream
running through the center of the room.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Dam Lobby
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.
>You are in the north end of a large cavernous room which was formerly
a reservoir.
However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream
running through the center of the room.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>Beg pardon?
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Dam Lobby
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.
>You are in the north end of a large cavernous room which was formerly
a reservoir.
However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream
running through the center of the room.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>Beg pardon?
>

Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Dam Lobby
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.
>You are in the north end of a large cavernous room which was formerly
a reservoir.
However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream
running through the center of the room.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>Beg pardon?
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.

There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.
>You are in the north end of a large cavernous room which was formerly
a reservoir.
However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream
running through the center of the room.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in the west end of a large temple.  On the south wall is an 
ancient inscription, probably a prayer in a long-forgotten language. 
The north wall is solid granite.  The entrance at the west end of the
room is through huge marble pillars.
Lying in a corner of the room is a small brass bell.
>Beg pardon?
>

>You are in the north end of a large cavernous room which was formerly
a reservoir.
However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream
running through the center of the room.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in the west end of a large temple.  On the south wall is an 
ancient inscription, probably a prayer in a long-forgotten language. 
The north wall is solid granite.  The entrance at the west end of the
room is through huge marble pillars.
Lying in a corner of the room is a small brass bell.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have

the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.

A bottle is sitting on the table.

 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden

nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.

>Taken.

A sword

axe.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A sword
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a narrow east-west passageway.  There is a narrow stairway
leading down at the north end of the room.
>You are in a deep ravine at a crossing with an east-west crawlway. 
Some stone steps are at the south of the ravine and a steep staircase
descends.
>You are at the south end of a large reservoir.
There is a western exit, a passageway south, and a steep pathway
climbing up along the edge of a cliff.
>You are on the south edge of a deep canyon.  Passages lead off
to the east, south, and northwest.  You can hear the sound of
flowing water below.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
>This room appears to have been the waiting room for groups touring
the dam.  There are exits here to the north and east marked
'Private', though the doors are open, and an exit to the south.
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are in what appears to have been the maintenance room for Flood
Control Dam #3, judging by the assortment of tool chests around the
room.  Apparently, this room has been ransacked recently, for most of
the valuable equipment is gone. On the wall in front of you is a
panel of buttons, which are labelled in EBCDIC. However, they are of
different colors:  Blue, Yellow, Brown, and Red. The doors to this
room are in the west and south ends.
There is an object which looks like a tube of toothpaste here.
There is a wrench here.
There is a screwdriver here.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>Click.
>Dam Lobby
There is a matchbook whose cover says 'Visit Beautiful FCD#3' here.
Some guidebooks entitled 'Flood Control Dam #3' are on the reception
desk.
>You are standing on the top of the Flood Control Dam #3, which was
quite a tourist attraction in times far distant.  There are paths to
the north, south, east, and down.
The sluice gates on the dam are closed.  Behind the dam, there can be
seen a wide lake.  A small stream is formed by the runoff from the
lake.
There is a control panel here.  There is a large metal bolt on the 
panel. Above the bolt is a small green plastic bubble.
The green bubble is glowing.
>The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.
>Deep Canyon
>Reservoir South
Lying half buried in the mud is an old trunk, bulging with jewels.
>You are in the north end of a large cavernous room which was formerly
a reservoir.
However, with the water level lowered, there is merely a wide stream
running through the center of the room.
There is a tunnel leaving the room to the north.
There is a small pump here.
>You are in an ancient room, long buried by the Reservoir.  There are
exits here to the southeast and upward.
On the shore lies Neptune's own crystal trident.
>You are in a small cave with an entrance to the north and a stairway
leading down.
>You are in a large square room with tall ceilings.  On the south wall
is an enormous mirror which fills the entire wall.  There are exits
on the other three sides of the room.
>There is a rumble from deep within the earth and the room shakes.
>You are in a narrow crawlway.  The crawlway leads from north to south.
However the south passage divides to the south and southwest.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are standing in a small circular room with a pedestal.  A set of
stairs leads up, and passages leave to the east and west.
There is an extremely valuable (perhaps original) grail here.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in the west end of a large temple.  On the south wall is an 
ancient inscription, probably a prayer in a long-forgotten language. 
The north wall is solid granite.  The entrance at the west end of the
room is through huge marble pillars.
Lying in a corner of the room is a small brass bell.
>You are in the east end of a large temple.  In front of you is what
appears to be an altar.
On the altar is a large black book, open to page 569.
On the two ends of the altar are burning candles.
>Taken.
>Temple
Lying in a corner of the room is a small brass bell.
>Beg pardon?
>
